name: Discord Activity
description: Shows live agent and tool activity as a Discord message that is updated and deleted when the agent finishes.

maxToolHistoryLength.description: Maximum number of tool calls to keep in history

maxStatusMessageLength.description: Maximum length of Discord status message content, capped at 1700 characters

orphanTtlSeconds.description: Time in seconds before orphaned tool calls are pruned

maxDisplaySeconds.description: Maximum idle time in seconds after status activity before automatic cleanup
